claims.claim_text: The indexed Leroy E. Barner is Leroy Elwood Barner, whose obituary and county veterans honor roll document U.S. Army and OSS service in World War II.
claims.evidence_excerpt: In World War II he was in an OSS unit
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact uncommon name is expanded to Leroy Elwood Barner and explicitly linked to an OSS unit, with Army and OSS service independently corroborated by a county veterans honor roll.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the uncommon exact name and middle initial, the index's commissioned Army rank, explicit OSS-unit service in the obituary, and an independent exact-full-name Army/OSS honor-roll entry. The Box 36 file and private identifier remain unreviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: Both external sources place the service in World War II. They do not establish the immediate pre-OSS affiliation, degree date, or prewar employer chronology.
claims.match_notes: Publish as a high-confidence identity, not confirmed, until the Box 36 file or identifier-linked military record is reviewed. Do not turn the undated University of Pittsburgh degree or later engineering employers into pre-OSS claims.
